newsitem.title: USA: Texas seasonally adjusted jobless rate edges lower.
newsitem.headline: Texas seasonally adjusted jobless rate edges lower.

text.p: The Texas seasonally adjusted unemployment rate dipped slightly to 5.4 percent in May from 5.5 percent in April as labor conditions continued to improve statewide, the Texas Workforce Commission said Tuesday.
"While the U.S. unemployment rate fell to nearly a 24-year low, Texas still has room to go before touching its low of 4.1 percent reached from March to May 1979," a Commission release stated.
The Texas labor force has also continued to expand, growing 24,500 over the month, according to the release.
